subcellular_context: presynapse; vesicle membrane; cytoplasmic vesicle membrane (GO CC; strongest q = 0.004)

Replaces the reviewed label 'Synaptic vesicle endocytosis and membrane trafficking' (Tobias Pohl, 2026-07-21), which the rule-based labels contradict.
